title: High Protein Chicken Bowl
description: Grilled chicken breast with quinoa and steamed vegetables
instructions: Season chicken breast with salt and pepper
Grill chicken for 6-7 minutes each side until cooked through
Cook quinoa according to package instructions
Assemble bowl with quinoa base, chicken, and vegetables
meal_prep_notes: Can be stored for up to 4 days in refrigerator
chef_tips: Marinate chicken in lemon and herbs for extra flavor

title: Overnight Oats with Berries
description: No-cook breakfast packed with protein and fiber
instructions: Mix oats with milk in a jar
Add Greek yogurt and mix well
Add sliced banana and chopped almonds
meal_prep_notes: Prepare 3-4 jars at once for the week
chef_tips: Add honey for sweetness if needed

title: Dal Tadka
description: Classic Indian lentil curry high in protein
instructions: Wash and boil lentils until soft
Heat oil in a pan for tadka
Add chopped onions and sauté until golden
Add ginger-garlic paste and cook for 2 minutes
Add tomatoes and cook until mushy
Pour tadka over boiled dal and simmer
meal_prep_notes: Stays fresh for 3-4 days, freeze for longer storage
chef_tips: Add a squeeze of lemon before serving

title: Paneer Tikka Wrap
description: Protein-rich Indian fusion wrap
instructions: Make roti from whole wheat flour
Marinate paneer in yogurt and spices
meal_prep_notes: Prep components separately, assemble when eating
chef_tips: Use mint chutney for extra flavor

title: Egg White Scramble
description: Low-calorie, high-protein breakfast
instructions: Pour in egg whites and scramble
chef_tips: Add herbs like oregano for flavor

title: Mediterranean Grilled Chicken with Couscous and Vegetables
description: A flavorful and protein-rich Mediterranean dish perfect for muscle gain, featuring grilled chicken, couscous, and a variety of vegetables.
instructions: Marinate the chicken: In a bowl, combine 20g olive oil, lemon juice, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper. Add the sliced chicken breast and coat well. Let it marinate for at least 15 minutes.
While the chicken marinates, prepare the couscous: Bring 300g of water to a boil. Remove from heat, add couscous, cover, and let it sit for 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork.
Heat a grill pan over medium-high heat and grill the marinated chicken for about 6-8 minutes per side, or until fully cooked and the internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C).
In a separate pan, heat the remaining olive oil (7g) and sauté the zucchini and tomatoes for 5-7 minutes, or until softened.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked couscous, grilled chicken, sautéed vegetables, crumbled feta cheese, and black olives. Mix well.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve warm.

title: Mediterranean Chicken and Quinoa Bowl
description: A high-protein Mediterranean dish featuring chicken, quinoa, and a medley of vegetables, perfect for muscle gain.
instructions: Cook the quinoa: Rinse the quinoa under cold water. In a pot, combine 75g of quinoa with 150ml of water. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer. Cover and cook for 15 minutes or until water is absorbed. Fluff with a fork and set aside.
Prepare the grill pan over medium heat. Season the chicken breast with salt, black pepper, and oregano. Drizzle with a little olive oil.
Grill the chicken: Place the chicken breast on the heated grill pan. Cook for 6-7 minutes on each side until the internal temperature reaches 75°C (165°F). Let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
Prepare the vegetables: Halve the cherry tomatoes, dice the cucumber, and slice the red onion. Crumble the feta cheese.
Assemble the bowl: Place the cooked quinoa in a serving bowl. Arrange the sliced grilled chicken, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, and red onion over the quinoa.
Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice. Sprinkle crumbled feta cheese on top.
Garnish with additional oregano if desired. Serve immediately.

title: Mediterranean Grilled Chicken with Quinoa and Chickpeas
description: A high-protein Mediterranean-inspired dish featuring grilled chicken, quinoa, and chickpeas with a blend of spices, perfect for muscle gain.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Season the chicken breasts with salt, black pepper, cumin, and paprika, then drizzle with 13.5g (1 tbsp) of olive oil.
Grill the chicken for about 6-7 minutes on each side, until fully cooked. Let rest before slicing.
Rinse the quinoa under cold water, then cook it in a pot with 370 grams of water until it's fluffy and water is absorbed.
In a pan, heat the remaining olive oil. Add chopped onion, minced garlic, and chopped red bell pepper. Sauté until soft.
Add the drained chickpeas to the pan and cook for another 2-3 minutes, then mix in the cooked quinoa.
Stir in lemon juice and chopped parsley, seasoning with additional salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the sliced grilled chicken over the quinoa and chickpea mix, garnishing with extra parsley if desired.

title: Tandoori Chicken with Spiced Brown Rice
description: A flavorful and protein-packed Indian dish featuring tandoori-spiced grilled chicken with a side of aromatic spiced brown rice. Perfect for fitness enthusiasts focused on fat loss.
instructions: In a bowl, combine yogurt, lemon juice, ginger garlic paste, cumin powder, coriander powder, turmeric powder, garam masala, paprika, and salt. Mix well to form a marinade.
Add chicken breast pieces to the marinade and coat thoroughly. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.

While the chicken marinates, cook the brown rice: rinse rice under cold water, then add to a pot with 370g of water. Add 1g of salt, bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer, cover, and cook for 25 minutes or until water is absorbed and rice is tender.
In a pan, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add cumin seeds, bay leaf, and sliced onion. Sauté until onions are golden brown. Set aside.
Preheat a grill or a grill pan over medium-high heat. Grill the marinated chicken breasts for about 6-7 minutes on each side, or until fully cooked and juices run clear.
Mix the sautéed onions into the cooked brown rice. Fluff with a fork and remove the bay leaf.
Serve the grilled tandoori chicken alongside the spiced brown rice.

title: Italian Grilled Chicken and Pesto Pasta
description: A high-protein Italian dish featuring grilled chicken and pasta tossed in a rich pesto sauce, perfect for athletes focusing on body recomposition.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan over medium-high heat.
Season the chicken breast with a pinch of salt and black pepper.
Grill the chicken breast for 5-6 minutes per side until fully cooked and grill marks appear. Let it rest for a few minutes before slicing it into strips.
In a large pot of boiling salted water, cook the penne pasta until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the cherry tomatoes and cook for 2-3 minutes until they start to soften.
Add the cooked pasta, sliced grilled chicken, and basil pesto to the skillet. Toss everything together to coat the pasta and chicken in the pesto.
Stir in the spinach and allow it to wilt slightly.
Serve the pasta topped with grated parmesan cheese.

title: Mediterranean Grilled Salmon and Quinoa Salad
description: A high-protein, nutrient-dense meal featuring grilled salmon with a vibrant quinoa salad, ideal for muscle gain and inspired by Mediterranean flavors.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Season the salmon fillet with a pinch of salt and black pepper.
Grill the salmon for 4-5 minutes per side, or until fully cooked. Set aside to rest.

Rinse 65 grams of quinoa under cold water. In a pot, combine the quinoa with 130 grams of water and a pinch of salt, bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes or until water is absorbed. Let it sit for 5 minutes and fluff with a fork.
In a large bowl, combine cooked quinoa, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, and red onion.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, chopped parsley, and a pinch of salt and pepper to make the dressing.
Pour the dressing over the quinoa salad and toss gently to combine.
Serve the grilled salmon atop the quinoa salad.

title: High-Protein Indian Chicken Curry with Brown Rice
description: A delicious and protein-packed Indian chicken curry served with brown rice, perfect for muscle gain and packed with flavors.
instructions: Rinse the brown rice thoroughly and soak in water for 20 minutes.
Boil 480 grams of water in a pot. Add the soaked rice, reduce heat, cover, and let it simmer for 25-30 minutes or until rice is cooked and water is absorbed.
Heat 14 grams of olive oil (about 1 tablespoon) in a pan over medium heat.
Add chopped onions and sauté until golden brown.
Add minced garlic and ginger, and sauté for another 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add chicken cubes to the pan and cook until they are white on the outside.
Mix in tomato puree, yogurt, coriander powder, cumin powder, turmeric powder, red chili powder, and salt. Stir well to combine.
Cover and cook on low heat for 15-20 minutes until the chicken is fully cooked and tender, stirring occasionally.
In a separate pan, heat the remaining olive oil and lightly toast the spices for garnishing, if desired.
Serve the chicken curry hot over cooked brown rice, garnishing with fresh coriander leaves if desired.

title: High-Protein Asian Teriyaki Chicken with Brown Rice and Vegetables
description: A delicious and hearty Asian-inspired dish perfect for muscle gain, featuring teriyaki-marinated chicken, nutritious brown rice, and a colorful medley of vegetables.
instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package instructions in a rice cooker or pot. This should take about 20 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, prepare the teriyaki sauce by mixing soy sauce, honey, sesame oil, ginger, and garlic in a bowl.
Slice the chicken breasts and marinate them in half of the teriyaki sauce for 15 minutes.
Heat olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the marinated chicken and cook until fully cooked and lightly browned, about 8 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the pan and set aside. In the same pan, add broccoli, carrot, and red bell pepper and stir-fry for about 5 minutes until slightly tender.
Return the chicken to the pan and add the remaining teriyaki sauce. Stir everything together and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes to heat through.
Serve the teriyaki chicken and vegetables over the cooked brown rice, garnished with chopped green onion.

title: Mediterranean Grilled Lamb with Couscous and Vegetables
description: A robust, protein-rich Mediterranean dish featuring grilled lamb accompanied by a bed of zesty couscous and roasted vegetables. Perfect for muscle gain.
instructions: In a bowl, marinade the cubed lamb with 10g of olive oil, minced garlic, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper. Let it rest for 15 minutes.
Cook the couscous according to package instructions, then fluff with a fork once done.
Toss cherry tomatoes, zucchini, and bell pepper with remaining olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Grill the vegetables until slightly charred, about 10 minutes, turning once.
Grill the lamb skewers for about 5-7 minutes on each side until cooked to your desired doneness.
Serve the grilled lamb over a bed of couscous, topped with grilled vegetables and garnish with chopped parsley.

title: Paneer Tikka with Quinoa Pilaf
description: A high-protein Indian dish featuring spiced paneer cubes grilled to perfection, served with a flavorful quinoa pilaf.
instructions: In a bowl, mix yogurt, turmeric powder, coriander powder, garam masala, lemon juice, minced garlic, grated ginger, and salt.
Add paneer cubes and bell pepper to the marinade, coat well, and let it sit for 20 minutes.
Heat 7g of olive oil in a pan over medium heat, add cumin seeds, and let them splutter.
Add sliced onions and sauté until golden brown.
Add rinsed quinoa and water, bring to a boil, then lower heat and cover. Cook until quinoa absorbs all the water, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, heat a grill pan with the remaining olive oil over medium heat.
Skewer the marinated paneer and bell pepper, and grill each side for about 3-4 minutes until nicely charred.
Serve the grilled paneer tikka hot alongside the quinoa pilaf.

title: Grilled Chicken with Mushroom Rice Pilaf
description: A high-protein continental dish featuring juicy grilled chicken breast with a flavorful mushroom rice pilaf, perfect for muscle gain.
instructions: Preheat a grill pan over medium-high heat. Season the chicken breast with salt and black pepper.
Brush the grill pan with 13.5 grams of olive oil. Grill the chicken breast for about 6-7 minutes on each side, or until fully cooked and grill marks appear. Remove from heat and let rest.
Meanwhile, heat the remaining 13.5 grams of olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add the diced onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced mushrooms to the saucepan and sauté until they release their moisture and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the uncooked brown rice and cook for 1-2 minutes to toast the rice lightly.

Pour in the chicken broth, adding salt and pepper to taste. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for about 20-25 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed.
Fluff the rice with a fork and stir in the chopped parsley.
Slice the grilled chicken and serve it over the mushroom rice pilaf.

title: Vegetarian Tofu Stir-Fry with Brown Rice
description: A high-protein Asian-inspired vegetarian stir-fry perfect for muscle gain goals.
instructions: Cook the brown rice: Bring 555ml of water to a boil, add the rice, cover, and simmer for 35-40 minutes until tender.
While the rice cooks, heat 15g of sesame oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the cubed tofu and cook until golden on all sides, about 8 minutes. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, add the remaining 12g of sesame oil, minced garlic, and ginger. Sauté for 1 minute.
Add the chopped broccoli and sliced red bell pepper to the pan, stir-frying for 5-7 minutes until tender-crisp.
Return the tofu to the pan, add soy sauce and stir to coat evenly. Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Remove from heat. Serve the stir-fry over cooked brown rice, garnished with sliced green onions and sesame seeds.

title: Mexican Chicken Burrito Bowl
description: A high-protein Mexican-inspired burrito bowl perfect for muscle gain, combining chicken, brown rice, and black beans with authentic spices.
instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package instructions until tender. Set aside.
Heat a grill pan over medium heat and brush with olive oil.
Season the chicken breast with cumin, chili powder, salt, and black pepper.
Grill the chicken breast for 6-7 minutes on each side or until fully cooked. Let it rest for 5 minutes, then slice.
In a separate pan, sauté the sliced bell pepper in a little olive oil until soft.
Drain and rinse the black beans, then heat them in a small saucepan.
Assemble the bowl by placing cooked brown rice at the bottom, followed by grilled chicken slices, sautéed bell peppers, and black beans.
Top with sliced avocado, chopped cilantro, and a drizzle of lime juice.

title: Mediterranean Chickpea and Quinoa Bowl
description: A high-protein Mediterranean-inspired bowl featuring seasoned chickpeas and quinoa, perfect for muscle gain.
instructions: Rinse and cook quinoa according to package instructions with a pinch of salt. Once cooked, set aside and allow to cool slightly.
In a pan, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add minced garlic and sauté for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add cooked chickpeas to the pan, along with cumin, salt, and black pepper. Stir well and cook for 5 minutes until chickpeas are heated through and slightly crisp.
In a large bowl, combine cooked quinoa, chickpeas, raw spinach, and diced red bell pepper.
Drizzle with lemon juice and toss everything together gently.
Top with crumbled feta cheese before serving.
Serve immediately or refrigerate for up to 2 days. Enjoy!

title: High-Protein Chicken Tikka with Brown Rice
description: A flavorful Indian-inspired chicken tikka served with nutritious brown rice, perfect for muscle gain.
instructions: In a bowl, combine yogurt, garlic, ginger, lemon juice, cumin powder, coriander powder, turmeric powder, paprika, and salt to prepare the marinade.
Add diced chicken breast to the marinade and mix until well coated. Let it marinate for at least 30 minutes in the refrigerator.
Cook brown rice according to package instructions or until tender. Set aside.
Preheat grill or stovetop grill pan over medium-high heat. Drizzle olive oil to prevent sticking.
Place marinated chicken on the grill, cooking each side for about 6-8 minutes, or until fully cooked and slightly charred.
Serve chicken tikka over cooked brown rice. Garnish with sliced cucumber and chopped mint leaves.

title: Vegetarian Quinoa and Lentil Power Bowl
description: A hearty and protein-packed vegetarian power bowl featuring quinoa, lentils, and a variety of vegetables, perfect for athletes aiming to build muscle.
instructions: Cook the quinoa: Rinse the quinoa thoroughly. In a pot, add 100g quinoa to 200g water and a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to a simmer. Cover and cook for about 15 minutes until water is absorbed. Fluff with a fork and set aside.

Cook the lentils: Rinse the lentils and place in a pot with enough water to cover by about 2 inches. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to a simmer. Cook for about 20 minutes or until tender. Drain excess water and set aside.
In a large pan, heat 15g of olive oil over medium heat. Add minced garlic and sauté for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add chopped spinach to the pan and sauté until wilted, about 3 minutes.
Add diced bell pepper and halved cherry tomatoes to the pan; cook for another 5 minutes until slightly softened.
In a large bowl, combine cooked quinoa, lentils, sautéed vegetables, and coat with the remaining olive oil and lemon juice. Mix well.
Season the mixture with salt and black pepper to taste.
Top the bowl with grated parmesan cheese and toasted pumpkin seeds before serving.

title: Teriyaki Salmon with Stir-Fried Vegetables and Brown Rice
description: A high-protein, Asian-inspired dish perfect for muscle gain, featuring teriyaki-glazed salmon served with a side of stir-fried vegetables and brown rice.
instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package instructions (use approximately 555g of water for 185g of rice). This will take about 30-35 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, prepare the teriyaki sauce by combining soy sauce, brown sugar, minced garlic, and minced ginger in a small bowl.

Heat 13.5g (1 tbsp) of olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the salmon fillets and cook for about 4 minutes on each side until fully cooked. Brush the teriyaki sauce on the salmon while cooking to glaze it.
In another pan, heat the remaining olive oil (13.5g) over medium heat. Add the broccoli, carrot, and bell pepper, and stir-fry for about 5-7 minutes until the vegetables are tender yet crisp.
Serve the cooked brown rice in bowls, top with a salmon fillet, and arrange the stir-fried vegetables on the side. Garnish with sliced green onions before serving.

title: Mexican Quinoa and Black Bean Bowl
description: A high-protein, vegetarian Mexican-inspired bowl perfect for muscle gain, featuring quinoa, black beans, and vibrant vegetables, all seasoned with traditional Mexican spices.
instructions: Cook the quinoa according to package instructions until light and fluffy. Use 370g of water to cook 185g of quinoa and let it absorb completely.
In a pan, heat 13.5g (1 tbsp) of olive oil over medium heat. Add chopped red onion and minced garlic and sauté until soft.
Add chopped red bell pepper and cooked sweet corn to the pan and cook for about 5 minutes until the vegetables are tender.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked quinoa, black beans, and sautéed vegetables. Mix well.
In a small bowl, prepare the dressing by mixing lime juice, the remaining olive oil, cumin, chipotle powder, salt, and black pepper.
Pour the dressing over the quinoa mixture and toss to combine evenly.
Top the quinoa bowl with sliced avocado and garnish with chopped cilantro.

title: Mediterranean Grilled Chicken Bowl with Brown Rice and Vegetables
description: A high-protein Mediterranean-inspired dish perfect for muscle gain, featuring grilled chicken breast, brown rice, and roasted vegetables.
instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package instructions. This should yield about 555g of cooked rice.
In a large bowl, combine sliced chicken breast, 15g olive oil, lemon juice, minced garlic, oregano, salt, and black pepper. Marinate for at least 15 minutes.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Grill the chicken slices for about 6-7 minutes on each side or until fully cooked and slightly charred. Remove from grill and let it rest.
Meanwhile, toss the sliced bell pepper, zucchini, and red onion with the remaining olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Grill the vegetables for about 8-10 minutes until they are tender and slightly charred.
Divide the cooked rice between two bowls, top with grilled chicken slices and grilled vegetables.
Serve immediately, optionally garnished with fresh herbs.

title: High-Protein Paneer and Lentil Curry
description: A hearty and protein-packed Indian dish combining paneer and lentils with rich spices, perfect for muscle gain.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the cumin seeds and let them sizzle for 30 seconds.
Add chopped onions, ginger, and garlic to the pan. Sauté until the onions are golden brown.
Stir in the turmeric powder, coriander powder, and garam masala. Cook for another minute to release the flavors.
Add the chopped tomatoes and green peppers, cooking until the tomatoes become soft.
Mix in the rinsed red lentils and 400g of water. Cover and simmer for about 20 minutes, or until the lentils are tender and the water is mostly absorbed.
Stir in the cubed paneer and salt, cooking for another 5 minutes until the paneer is heated through.
Adjust the consistency with remaining water if needed. Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve hot.

title: Grilled Chicken with Herbed Quinoa and Roasted Vegetables
description: A high-protein, continental dish perfect for muscle gain, featuring grilled chicken breast, herbed quinoa, and a side of roasted vegetables.
instructions: Toss the sliced bell pepper, zucchini, and carrot with 5g of olive oil, salt, and black pepper. Place them on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 25-30 minutes, turning halfway through.
Rinse and cook the quinoa according to package instructions. Once cooked, fluff with a fork and stir in chopped parsley, lemon juice, and minced garlic.
Heat a grill pan over medium-high heat. Brush the chicken breast with the remaining olive oil, season with salt and black pepper, and grill for 6-8 minutes on each side until fully cooked.
Plate the grilled chicken with herbed quinoa and roasted vegetables. Serve warm.

title: High-Protein Tofu Stir-Fry with Black Rice
description: A protein-packed vegetarian Asian recipe featuring tofu and black rice, ideal for muscle gain.
instructions: Cook the black rice by adding it to a pot with 300ml of water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to simmer, cover and cook for 30-40 minutes until tender and water is absorbed.
While the rice is cooking, heat a large pan over medium-high heat and add sesame oil.
Add diced tofu to the pan and stir-fry until golden brown on all sides, about 8 minutes. Remove tofu from pan and set aside.
In the same pan, add minced garlic, ginger, and sliced carrots. Stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Add chopped broccoli and continue to stir-fry for another 3 minutes until vegetables are tender-crisp.
Return the tofu to the pan and add soy sauce. Stir to combine and let everything warm through, about 2 minutes.
Serve the tofu stir-fry over the cooked black rice. Garnish with chopped scallions and toasted sesame seeds.

title: Mexican Chicken Fajitas with Brown Rice
description: A high-protein, flavorful Mexican dish combining seasoned chicken fajitas with wholesome brown rice, perfect for muscle gain.
instructions: Cook the brown rice: In a pot, bring 555ml (triple the dry weight) of water to a boil. Add the brown rice, reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 30 minutes or until the rice is tender and has absorbed the water. Keep warm.
In a large bowl, combine sliced chicken breast, lime juice, minced garlic, cumin, chili powder, paprika, salt, and black pepper. Mix well to coat the chicken evenly.

Heat 15g of olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add the marinated chicken slices and cook for 5-7 minutes, turning occasionally, until fully cooked and slightly charred. Remove the chicken from the pan and set aside.
In the same pan, add the remaining 15g of olive oil. Add sliced bell pepper and onion, and sauté for 5 minutes until the vegetables are tender and slightly caramelized.
Return the cooked chicken to the pan with the vegetables, stir to combine, and cook for an additional 2 minutes to heat through.
Serve the chicken fajitas hot over the cooked brown rice. Optionally, garnish with fresh cilantro or a squeeze of lime.

title: Mediterranean Protein-Packed Chickpea and Quinoa Salad
description: A high-protein, vegetarian Mediterranean salad perfect for muscle gain, featuring chickpeas, quinoa, and feta cheese, enhanced with fresh vegetables and herbs.
instructions: Cook the quinoa by boiling 80g of dry quinoa in water until it absorbs the water and triples in size. This will yield approximately 250g of cooked quinoa.
Rinse and drain the canned chickpeas to remove excess sodium. Add them to a large mixing bowl.
Dice the cucumber, halve the cherry tomatoes, and dice the red onion, then add them to the mixing bowl with chickpeas.
Add the crumbled feta cheese to the mixture.
In a separate small bowl, whisk together the olive oil and lemon juice to create a dressing. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Pour the dressing over the salad ingredients and toss gently to combine.
Chop the fresh parsley and sprinkle over the salad for added flavor.
Serve immediately or refrigerate for up to 24 hours for flavors to meld.

title: Indian Spiced Paneer and Chickpea Bowl
description: A high-protein Indian-style dish featuring spiced paneer and chickpeas, served with fragrant basmati rice and a side of sautéed spinach, perfect for muscle gain.
instructions: Cook the brown rice by adding it to a pot with 185g of water. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes until water is absorbed and rice is tender.
Heat 6g of olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add cumin seeds and let them sizzle for a few seconds.
Add chopped onion, garlic, and ginger. Sauté for about 5 minutes until the onion is translucent.
Stir in turmeric, coriander, and red chili powder. Cook for 1 minute.
Add tomato paste, paneer cubes, and cooked chickpeas. Stir well to coat everything with the spices. Cook for 10-12 minutes, stirring occasionally.
In another pan, heat the remaining olive oil. Add spinach and sauté until wilted, about 3 minutes.
Once everything is cooked, layer the rice at the bottom of a bowl. Top with the paneer and chickpea mixture, and place sautéed spinach on the side.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped coriander if desired.

title: High-Protein Vegetarian Continental Stir-Fry
description: A delicious high-protein vegetarian stir-fry, ideal for muscle gain, featuring tofu and a mix of colorful vegetables with a soy-ginger sauce.
instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package instructions, boiling it in ample water until tender. This should take about 25 minutes. Once cooked, drain the excess water and set aside.
While the rice is cooking, heat 13.5g of olive oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the cubed tofu to the pan and stir-fry for 5-7 minutes until golden brown. Remove the tofu from the pan and set aside.
In the same pan, add another 13.5g of olive oil and stir-fry the minced garlic and ginger for about 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the sliced red bell pepper, broccoli florets, and sliced carrot. Stir-fry the vegetables for about 5-7 minutes until they are just tender but still crisp.
Return the tofu to the pan with the vegetables. Pour in the soy sauce and toss everything to coat evenly. Cook for another 2-3 minutes.
Serve the stir-fry over the cooked brown rice and sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds.

title: Asian Grilled Chicken with Brown Rice and Stir-Fried Vegetables
description: A high-protein Asian-inspired meal featuring grilled chicken, brown rice, and stir-fried vegetables, perfect for muscle gain.
instructions: Marinate the chicken breast with 10 grams of soy sauce, 5 grams of minced ginger, and 5 grams of minced garlic. Let it sit for at least 15 minutes.
Cook the brown rice according to the package instructions. Use 150 grams of dry brown rice, which will yield approximately 450 grams once cooked.
While the rice is cooking, heat a grill pan over medium-high heat and grill the marinated chicken breast until fully cooked, about 6-7 minutes per side. Let it rest for a few minutes before slicing.
In a wok or large frying pan, heat 13.5 grams of sesame oil over medium heat. Add the remaining ginger and garlic and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the broccoli and carrots to the pan and continue to stir-fry for about 5-7 minutes, until vegetables are tender but still crisp.
Add the remaining soy sauce and sliced green onions to the vegetables and stir well to combine.
Serve the sliced grilled chicken over a bed of cooked brown rice, topped with stir-fried vegetables. Garnish with toasted sesame seeds.

title: Vegetarian Mexican Burrito Bowl
description: A high-protein, vegetarian Mexican burrito bowl packed with flavors and nutrients, perfect for muscle gain.
instructions: Cook quinoa: Rinse 120g of quinoa and cook it in 240g of water until fully absorbed and fluffy. This usually takes around 15 minutes.
Prepare black beans: Drain and rinse 150g of canned black beans. If using dry beans, cook them until soft.
Prepare toppings: Slice 100g avocado, halve 100g cherry tomatoes, dice 50g red onion, slice 10g jalapeno, and cut 50g of corn kernels if using fresh corn.
Heat olive oil: In a pan, heat 13.5g olive oil over medium heat and sauté the red onions until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Combine ingredients: In a large bowl, combine the cooked quinoa, black beans, sautéed onions, corn, cherry tomatoes, and shredded cheddar cheese (60g).
Add flavor: Squeeze the juice of one lime (50g) into the mixture, add 10g chopped cilantro, and season with 5g salt and 2g black pepper.
Serve: Top the bowl with sliced avocado and jalapenos. Garnish with additional cilantro if desired.
